bullets.text: Resolved an issue where the icon for the canted irons on the EF88 was misplaced
Fixed an issue where match ammo for the M2010 and SVK had unintended amounts of damage reduction versus opponents in water.
Corrected issues related to weapon stats not updating correctly for the EF88, BROD and VSSM.
Updated descriptions on several weapons, including mention of subsonic ammo, which is a default attribute on the M45A1 and vz.61.
The weight of the long and lightened suppressor in the L115 has been swapped.
Corrected an issue where Vertical Grips on RPKM and RPK-74M have an offset hand position when a laser or light is equipped.
